Use Image 1 as the exact identity and scene reference. Use Image 2 as the exact clothing reference.

Replace only the outfit worn by the woman in Image 1 with the complete outfit shown in Image 2.

- same face and identity,
- same facial proportions,
- same hairstyle and hair color,
- same skin tone,
- same body shape and proportions,
- same pink smartphone,
- same mirror-selfie pose,
- same camera angle,
- same boutique background,
- same lighting,
- same illuminated 'SHOP_NAME' sign.

- same garment type,
- same colors,
- same fabric appearance,
- same pattern and print placement,
- same neckline,
- same sleeves,
- same waist construction,
- same buttons, zippers, ribbons, lace, stitching, pockets, trims, and accessories,
- same garment length,
- same silhouette,
- same layers,
- same fit and design details.

Do not redesign, simplify, beautify, recolor, shorten, lengthen, or change any part of the outfit. Do not alter the woman's identity, the boutique scene, the phone, or the shop sign.

config.text:
SUBJECT: A highly detailed fashion and lifestyle photo featuring [Subject] as the main visual focus, using [Model] as character reference.

MODEL REFERENCE: [Model] — a handsome young Asian male with fair skin, slightly wavy layered hair styled naturally to the side, wearing clear/transparent thin-frame glasses, slim build, subtle relaxed facial expression with a natural, soft gaze slightly upward and to the side — not stiff, not overly posed, looking genuinely at ease as if caught in a candid moment.

POSITION: Standing upright outdoors, framed from mid-thigh up, body angled slightly to the side, one hand resting casually in the front pocket of the shorts, the other arm relaxed by the side, weight shifted naturally onto one leg for a candid, unposed stance.

OUTFIT: [Outfit] — light blue long-sleeve button-up shirt with sleeves casually rolled up to the forearms, worn open over a plain white crew-neck t-shirt, paired with light beige/khaki tailored shorts, and a black wristwatch.

QUALITY & STYLE: Candid street-style photography, natural everyday lifestyle aesthetic, realistic and unposed feel, high-quality smartphone camera look, sharp focus throughout the entire image — subject AND background both fully in focus, no depth-of-field blur, no bokeh effect, no cinematic look, no dramatic color grading, no film-style filters, flat natural color rendering true to real life.

ENVIRONMENT & BACKGROUND: An outdoor urban street setting, tall green trees and trimmed hedges lining a paved sidewalk, a low decorative stone/tile wall and street lamp post in the background, all background elements sharp and clearly visible, everyday realistic city atmosphere.

LIGHTING & COMPOSITION: Soft, even, overcast-style natural daylight with no direct or visible sunlight, no harsh highlights, no golden-hour warm tones, diffused flat lighting similar to a cloudy day, realistic neutral skin tones, no dramatic shadows, balanced composition with the subject centered slightly off to one side, entire frame in sharp focus from foreground to background.

ASPECT RATIO 9:16
